ops.text: The effect is not confined to the hexagonal lattice: exact simulation of the 17-qubit colour-code circuit CC17 gives a T-state logical error rate of $2.8\times 10^{-9}$ at $p=10^{-3}$, well above its S-state proxy [⟦new.B2⟧].
